scenes.narration: This black spot hides three thousand galaxies.

scenes.title: NASA stared at ==nothing==
scenes.narration: In 1995, NASA pointed Hubble at the emptiest patch of sky it could find.

scenes.label: of staring at one spot
scenes.narration: For ten days straight. Three hundred and forty two photos.

scenes.title: It **exploded** with light
scenes.narration: And when the picture came back, it exploded with light.

scenes.headline: Every dot is a **galaxy.**
scenes.narration: Almost every dot you see is a whole galaxy, not a star.
And that patch was the size of a tennis ball, seen from a hundred metres away.

scenes.headline: Now imagine the **whole sky.**
scenes.narration: Now imagine the whole sky. Follow for part two.
